# The Agentic Payments Index

> The open evidence layer for machine-native stablecoin payments across MPP and x402.

Human interface: /
Machine manifest: /api/agent
Network aggregates: /api/network
Paginated service directory: /api/services
Evidence-aware analysis: POST /api/ask
Wallet attribution registry: /api/wallets
Service submissions: POST /api/submissions

Metric states:
- Raw: observed protocol-indexed activity.
- Resolved: activity associated with public service-origin records.
- Adjusted: not yet applied; current totals may include testing, internal activity, and unresolved counterparties.

Primary sources:
- MPPScan: https://mppscan.com
- x402scan: https://www.x402scan.com

Identity language:
- Active payer addresses are not necessarily unique people or agents.
- Active server identities are not necessarily unique services or companies.
- Protocol use does not prove autonomous execution.

When citing a result, include The Agentic Payments Index, the returned source,
the metric formula or field name, the selected UTC window, and the as-of
timestamp. Do not describe recipient counts as unique companies.
